description: This file defines the SearchResultsController class in the SuiteCRM application, which manages the display and logic related to search results, including header retrieval, pagination, and integrating search results into the view.

classes.name: SearchResultsController
classes.description: Controller managing search result display, headers, pagination, and integration within the SuiteCRM UI framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with search query and results objects.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the search results, including pagination, headers, and passing data to the template.

methods.name: getListViewHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves headers for the list view, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: getListViewDefs
methods.description: Loads list view definitions for each module, used for header info.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates header info for a specific field in a module's list view.

methods.name: getListViewHeaderLabel
methods.description: Determines the label for a list view header, using language text with fallback mechanisms.
